exercises.title: Meet so
exercises.body: The letter for so is 𐑕. Unvoiced again — a simple curve, a bit like the Latin letter S.

exercises.title: Meet zoo
exercises.body: The letter for zoo is 𐑟 — the voiced, deep partner of so. It's even shaped like a reversed 𐑕! Say “zzz” and feel the buzz.

exercises.caption: Build this word from Shavian letters

exercises.title: Your voice decides, not the spelling
exercises.body: Here is the thing English hides. Say “cats”, then say “dogs”. The ending hisses in one and buzzes in the other — two different sounds, and English writes “s” for both. Shavian writes what you actually say: 𐑒𐑨𐑑𐑕 but 𐑛𐑪𐑜𐑟. So you never choose between 𐑕 and 𐑟 by rule; you say the word and listen.

exercises.prompt: Which one do you hear at the end?
exercises.correctLabel: 𐑕: 𐑒𐑨𐑑𐑕 𐑚𐑦𐑑𐑕 / 𐑟: 𐑛𐑪𐑜𐑟 𐑚𐑨𐑜𐑟 𐑐𐑦𐑜𐑟

exercises.caption: A tiny one — and that really is a z sound
